data.gender_notes: Harv is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Havvah', meaning 'God of War'. In the Old Testament, Har is mentioned as a god of the storm and battle, sometimes identified with the Canaanite god Baal. The name Harv is a modern variation of Har and carries the same meaning and spiritual significance. The name Harv carries the meaning “God of War” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harv usually hope their child will grow to embody god of war and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harv belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of War.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harv total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
